action_instruction: Checking whether the checkout page is present
intent: whether the Checkout heading is present in the page main content

action_params.condition: you are still on the checkout page
action_params.query: whether the Checkout heading is present in the page main content

action_instruction: Checking whether the order thank-you message is present
intent: whether the text "Thank you for your order" is visible in the page content

action_params.condition: the page does not show "Thank you for your order"
action_params.query: whether the text "Thank you for your order" is visible in the page content

action_instruction: Checking whether the SAB order number line is present
intent: whether an "Order number:" line with an SAB- number is visible in the page content

action_params.condition: no "Order number:" line with an SAB- number appears
action_params.query: whether an "Order number:" line with an SAB- number is visible in the page content

assertion_tree.description: you are still on the checkout page, the page does not show "Thank you for your order", and no "Order number:" line with an SAB- number appears

sub_results.description: you are still on the checkout page
the page does not show "Thank you for your order"
no "Order number:" line with an SAB- number appears

assertion_tree.verification: The current page remains the checkout page and does not show an order confirmation or an SAB- order-number line.
